recognize_zh: 骨髓抹片中大量小淋巴球，夾雜細胞質較多、核偏心的漿細胞樣淋巴球（plasmacytoid lymphocytes）與漿細胞，從淋巴球到漿細胞呈連續光譜，並散在少數含顆粒的肥大細胞，符合淋巴漿細胞淋巴瘤（Waldenström 巨球蛋白血症）。
features: Hypercellular aspirate dominated by small mature lymphocytes with clumped chromatin and scant cytoplasm
Admixed plasmacytoid lymphocytes with eccentric nuclei and moderate basophilic cytoplasm
Scattered mature plasma cells with perinuclear hof
Occasional granulated cells consistent with mast cells
Reduced residual granulocytic and erythroid precursors; scattered neutrophils
describe_en: Bone marrow aspirate smear is cellular and shows a marked increase in small lymphoid cells with round nuclei, clumped chromatin and scant cytoplasm. Admixed are plasmacytoid lymphocytes with eccentric nuclei and more abundant basophilic cytoplasm and scattered mature plasma cells, forming a spectrum of lymphoplasmacytic differentiation. Occasional granulated cells compatible with mast cells are noted, and normal hematopoietic precursors are reduced. In the setting of an IgM paraprotein and MYD88 L265P mutation, findings are consistent with lymphoplasmacytic lymphoma (Waldenström macroglobulinemia).

ddx.dx: Marginal zone lymphoma with plasmacytic differentiation
ddx.vs: Morphology overlaps; MZL usually lacks MYD88 L265P and has monocytoid/villous cells, so molecular and clinical correlation are needed.
CLL cells are uniform small lymphocytes with smudge cells and lack a plasmacytoid component, and are CD5+/CD23+.
IgM myeloma shows sheets of clonal plasma cells without a clonal small B-lymphocyte population, and often has t(11;14).
Reactive infiltrates are polytypic with a mixed population and no monoclonal IgM or MYD88 mutation.
